real_estate_have_experience_with.question: Do you have experience with real estate SEO?
real_estate_have_experience_with.answer: Yes. AVR Web Consulting has run SEO and AI visibility programmes for real estate businesses across India, the USA, UK, UAE and Europe. We work to buyers, tenants, investors and NRI purchasers search behaviour and a typical 30–270 days decision cycle rather than applying a generic checklist.

real_estate_long_real_estate.question: How long does real estate SEO take to show results?
real_estate_long_real_estate.answer: Technical and on-page fixes usually move impressions within 3–6 weeks. Meaningful ranking and enquiry growth typically lands in months 3–6, with compounding gains after that. Sites with existing authority move faster than new domains.

real_estate_real_estate_seo.question: What does real estate SEO cost at AVR Web Consulting?
real_estate_real_estate_seo.answer: Programmes start at $100/month for focused local or single-service work and scale with content volume, number of locations and competition. We quote after an initial audit so the scope matches the opportunity, not a template.

real_estate_which_keywords_matter.question: Which keywords matter most for real estate?
real_estate_which_keywords_matter.answer: The highest-value clusters are "flats for sale in <locality>" and price-per-sqft queries; project name and builder reputation searches; investment and rental-yield research. We prioritise commercial intent first, then supporting informational content that feeds both search rankings and AI answers.

real_estate_get_real_estate.question: How do you get real estate brands mentioned by ChatGPT and Perplexity?
real_estate_get_real_estate.answer: When buyers ask AI about a locality, models reach for structured, data-rich local pages. Publishing tables of prices and amenities makes you the retrievable source.

real_estate_structured_data_implement.question: What structured data do you implement for real estate?
real_estate_structured_data_implement.answer: We deploy RealEstateListing + Place + LocalBusiness alongside sitewide Organization and BreadcrumbList markup, validated against Google's Rich Results Test and kept in sync as content changes.

real_estate_also_handle_paid.question: Do you also handle paid ads for real estate clients?
real_estate_also_handle_paid.answer: Yes. Google Ads and social advertising run alongside SEO so you have demand today while organic and AI visibility compound. Many clients start with paid for speed and shift budget to organic as rankings mature.

real_estate_which_kpis_report.question: Which KPIs do you report for real estate?
real_estate_which_kpis_report.answer: We report qualified site-visit enquiries, locality keyword coverage, map-pack visibility per office, cost per lead vs portal spend — plus AI visibility tracking that shows how often your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

real_estate_work_manual_safe.question: Is the work manual and safe for real estate sites?
real_estate_work_manual_safe.answer: Every link, citation and content asset is produced manually. We use no PBNs, no automated link tools and no AI-spun content — critical in a sector where portals dominate every generic property keyword.

real_estate_work_with_our.question: Can you work with our existing real estate website?
real_estate_work_with_our.answer: Yes. We audit and improve what you have first — most sites gain more from fixing crawlability, structure and content depth than from a rebuild. If a rebuild genuinely pays back, our web team can handle it.
